svg.title: Figure 5-2 · Toyota authority (controls_allowed) state machine (SM-TOY-AUTH)
svg.desc: State diagram of SM-TOY-AUTH (Toyota authority (controls_allowed)) with states NOT_ALLOWED, ALLOWED; initial state NOT_ALLOWED. Transitions: T1 NOT_ALLOWED to ALLOWED on 0x1D2 valid (partial); T8 NOT_ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on 0x1D2 valid (partial); T2 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on 0x1D2 valid (implemented); T3 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on any RX (implemented); T4 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on RX of checked message (partial); T5 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on safety_tick (100 Hz safety task) (partial); T6 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on 1 Hz tick (not implemented); T7 any to NOT_ALLOWED on safety mode set (0xdc, heartbeat loss, harness change) (implemented); T9 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on TX frame rejected by a content check (not implemented); T10a ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on safety task: heartbeat check (partial); T10b ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on safety task: command freshness check (implemented, reference build); T10c ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on 0x1D2 / 0x1D3 (partial, reference build); T10d ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on platform fault (not implemented); T10e ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on driver steering override (not implemented); T11 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on TX frame over the per-ID rate budget (implemented, reference build); T12 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on safety task: driver torque check (not implemented); T13 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on SPI error (partial); T14 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on car-side CAN bus-off or persistent TX failure (partial); T15 ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on safety task: forwarding supervision (not implemented). Implemented means implemented at the baseline with host tests only; nothing is verified.
svg.text: Generated from the record state-machines/sm-toy-auth.yaml; arrow colour = implementation state of the cited SWSRs (WP-W-02 Baseline column). Nothing is verified.
[any RX check lagging (5 periods), below 10 Hz, or invalid]
TX frame rejected by a content check
[no SoC heartbeat for > 0.3 s in a car mode]
/ clear; siren 3 s when authority was granted (panda c33343b)
[CRUISE_ACTIVE while MAIN_ON is off for > 150 ms]
TX frame over the per-ID rate budget
[3 rejected frames in one 125 ms half-window]
car-side CAN bus-off or persistent TX failure
[relay driven and no camera-side frame for > t_fwd, or camera-side bus-off]
Reactions that do not change the state (record field non_revoking; drawn neutral: the §5 table gives them no Status column)
EPS reports a fault (LKA_STATE in the fault set) → lateral frames with torque or steer request refused; authority kept (SWSR-110)
gas pressed → longitudinal actuation blocked; authority kept (SWSR-305)

g.text: Implemented at the baseline (WP-W-02 Baseline; host tests only, not verified)
dashed frame: an arrow starting on it applies in every state
